name: kaspa-x402-protocol
description: Kaspa x402 protocol specifications, SDKs, adapters and verification tooling.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run test:self && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/covenant run test:self && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/server run test:self && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/client run test:self && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/facilitator run test:self && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/cli run test:self && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/adapters run test:self && node --test scripts/kaspa-consensus-source.test.mjs scripts/npm-pack-output.test.mjs scripts/covenant-artifact-clean-room.test.mjs scripts/read-bounded-response.test.mjs scripts/proof-output-security.test.mjs scripts/transaction-input-outpoint.test.mjs scripts/payment-persistence.test.mjs scripts/live-chain-continuity.test.mjs scripts/live-proof-fees.test.mjs scripts/live-adapter-admission.test.mjs && npm run test:x402-compatibility
scripts.vectors:tx-v1: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/covenant run build && node scripts/generate-tx-v1-vectors.mjs
scripts.vectors:batch-interop: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/covenant run build && node scripts/generate-batch-interop-vector.mjs
scripts.check:batch-interop-vector: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/covenant run build && node scripts/generate-batch-interop-vector.mjs --check && node --test scripts/batch-interop-crosslinks.test.mjs
scripts.check:x402-compatibility: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build:self && npm run test:x402-compatibility
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run validate:schemas && npm run check:covenant-fixtures && npm run check:hash-chain-http-vector && npm run check:exact-http-vector && npm run check:exact-interop-vector && npm run check:batch-interop-vector && npm run proof:offline && npm run pack:public:dry-run
